props.text: #207: afkv2: port /afk:prototype skill, with optional lavish commenting

## Goal
Port the v1 `/afk:prototype` skill (`skills/afk/prototype/`) to afkv2 as `/afkv2:prototype`.

## What v1 does
- Optional design-layer stage: after the PRD, before the SDD; only for features with net-new or changed UI (self-gates `no_ui`).
- Anchors to the real frontend (design-system catalog → running app screenshots → frontend source).
- Writes one self-contained, drivable HTML mockup (inline JS, fixtures, app shell + neighbor stubs); 2-3 divergent variants when direction is unclear.
- Iterates on human feedback, then gates on a capability walk (every user story / AC clickable or logged as a gap) and a fidelity pass vs the live app.
- Writes `prototype/<screen>.html` + `PROTOTYPE.md`; optional `claude.ai/design` share push.

## New requirement
- Lavish is **optional**: the developer can comment directly on the mockup UI (element annotations) instead of only via chat. Chat-only must still work.

## Open points (for the grill)
- afkv2 has no `design-system` skill: what replaces the catalog anchor?
- Map v1 lavish render point to afkv2 `use-lavish` / `visualize`.
- Downstream consumers in afkv2: `propose-solution`, `propose-verification`.
- Earlier decision (2026-10-09) to add a logic/state-model branch from mattpocock/skills `LOGIC.md`: in or out of this port?
- Keep the `claude.ai/design` share push?

**Verdict:** two pains. (1) afkv2 cannot settle new UI before the design, so screen choices are redone late. (2) Notes in chat lose which element you meant; a note pinned on the mockup keeps it.

Is this the pain, or is there more (for example, sharing with stakeholders)?

examples.title: A new list screen in an app with a catalog

props.text:
- **Start:** PRD with 2 stories (see orders, filter by status); the service has a catalog; `live` block present.
- **Run:** the agent starts the app, screenshots the shell and the nearest page type, writes `prototype/orders.html` with 12 synthetic orders; you pin "filter too far right" on the filter bar; the agent moves it.
- **Result:** both stories clickable from the nav entry; `PROTOTYPE.md` with a 2-row coverage table, fidelity `live-verified`; later 2 ui-e2e rows trace to it.

examples.title: No running app and no catalog

props.text:
- **Start:** no `live` block, no catalog, lavish host not running.
- **Run:** the agent reads the frontend source for tokens and components, gives you the `file://` path; you note in chat.
- **Result:** mockup settles with fidelity `source-only`, flagged in `PROTOTYPE.md`.

examples.title: Live screenshots hold real customer records

props.text:
- **Start:** the live app runs against a shared database with real names.
- **Risk:** the agent lifts markup from the live page, and real names land in the committed mockup or catalog card.
- **Result wanted:** fixtures are synthetic; the secret scan runs on every written file before you commit.
